DST ends first Sunday in November, which in 2026 is November 2? Actually DST ends on first Sunday of November at 2am local, which in 2026 is November 2. At 09:30 America/New_York on November 2 2026, need to determine if it's before or after the shift. Typically DST ends at 2:00 am, moving clocks back one hour. So before 2am it's EDT (UTC-4), after 2am it's EST (UTC-5). 09:30 is after 2am, so it would be EST (UTC-5). So 09:30 EST = 14:30 UTC? Wait: EST is UTC-5, so 09:30 EST = 14:30 UTC. Indeed the task says must also be 14:30 Europe/London time. London in November 2026 after last Sunday of October (which is October 25 2026) will be on GMT (UTC+0). Actually UK switches to GMT on last Sunday of October. So November 2 is after that, so London time is GMT (UTC+0). So 14:30 Europe/London = 14:30 UTC. So 09:30 EST corresponds to 14:30 UTC, matches London time. Good.

Thus event start in UTC: 2026-11-02T14:30:00Z. Duration 30 minutes, end at 15:00 UTC i.e., 2026-11-02T15:00:00Z.
